# OneMoreShort

Autonomous YouTube Shorts factory for a US audience: trend research, topic selection, script, storyboard,
continuity bible, five Veo-style prompts, post-production, quality gate, metadata, upload, analytics,
retention analysis and content intelligence that improves the next video.

**Operating mode (default): free.** The five visual clips are generated by the operator in Google Flow with
the Google AI subscription credits already paid for. Everything else is automatic and runs on free tiers:
Gemini text/vision/TTS free tier, YouTube Data + Analytics APIs, edge-tts, RSS trend feeds, ffmpeg.
No Veo API call is made unless `generation.mode: veo` is set deliberately.

## Quick start

```powershell
# 1. one-time
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.cli init-db
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.cli doctor

# 2. one production (mock mode works with no keys at all)
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.cli new                # -> OMS-20260908-0001
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.cli export-prompts OMS-20260908-0001
#    open storage/prompts/OMS-20260908-0001/MANUAL_VIDEO_HANDOFF.txt, generate 5 clips in Flow,
#    drop them in storage/manual_input/OMS-20260908-0001/segment_01.mp4 ... segment_05.mp4
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.cli watch OMS-20260908-0001   # waits, then edits, captions, renders, uploads

# 3. every day (or register scripts\register_daily_task.ps1)
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.cli daily
```

Result: `storage/renders/<ID>/OneMoreShort_Final.mp4` (1080x1920, H.264/AAC 48 kHz, max 40 s, burned captions).

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `doctor` | Checks mode, ffmpeg, keys and what is missing for live mode |
| `new [--force]` | Creates a production id (respects `limits.max_videos_per_day`) |
| `export-prompts ID` | Trend discovery, research, script, storyboard, continuity bible, five prompt files + hand-off |
| `collect-clips ID` | Validates and normalises the five clips, extracts boundary frames, concatenates |
| `finish ID` | Narration, mix, captions, render, quality gate, metadata, upload (if enabled) |
| `resume ID` | Continues from the persisted state; prints the exact human action if clips are missing |
| `watch ID` | Polls the inbox and runs collect + finish automatically when the five clips arrive |
| `daily` | Analytics -> learn -> advance today's production (the scheduled entry point) |
| `analytics` | Captures due checkpoints (10 min ... 30 d) for every published video |
| `learn` | Recomputes insights, strategy weights, knowledge base and per-video reports |
| `report ID` | Prints the performance report (WHAT WORKED / WHAT FAILED / NEXT VIDEO RECOMMENDATION) |
| `status ID`, `list`, `metrics`, `costs` | Observability |
| `youtube-auth` | One-time OAuth consent (upload + read-only + analytics scopes) |

## Documentation

- `SETUP.md`: environment, free-tier keys, YouTube OAuth, Flow prerequisites
- `PIPELINE.md`: stages, states, continuity strategy, post-production, analytics and learning
- `OPERATIONS.md`: daily routine, scheduler, human-action protocol, budget
- `TROUBLESHOOTING.md`: known failures and fixes
- `API.md`: module map, CLI reference and the external APIs used
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `docs/SPEC.md`: design, decision log, original specification

## Layout

```
app/          core, llm, trends, research, scripting, storyboard, continuity, veo, manual_video,
              audio, captions, editing, quality, metadata, youtube, analytics, intelligence, pipeline, cli
config/       default.yaml (+ optional local.yaml, git-ignored)
storage/      per-production artefacts: prompts, manual_input, segments, frames, audio, captions, renders, reports
database/     oms.db (SQLite)   logs/   secrets/ (git-ignored)   scripts/   tests/
```

Run the tests with `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest` (offline, about two minutes; ffmpeg required).
